offline_rendering.stack: Existing locked Explorer @playwright/test and installed Chrome; local canvas decoding/redaction, caption rendering and contact-sheet rendering only
offline_rendering.initial_failure: Restricted environment aborted the installed Chrome process before rendering; approved shell execution was then used for the local-only renderer.
offline_rendering.format_correction: Native screenshot bytes were JPEG despite staging .png filenames. The renderer was corrected to decode actual JPEG bytes and validate 3024 by 1898 dimensions, then save privacy-redacted PNG masters.
offline_rendering.layout_correction: Offline document scroll was reset before each 1920 by 1080 derivative so status captions were not clipped.
offline_rendering.does_not_count_as: A new live S12 prompt, evidence retrieval, permission change, successful sidebar repair or model comparison
